title: Second Hardy–Littlewood zeta-function conjecture
exact_target: Does every sufficiently high interval of the specified length contain at least a constant times its length many odd-order zeros of the Riemann zeta function on its critical line?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9400183 (AMR-093-0183). CC BY 4.0.

Wikipedia contributors, \emph{Hardy--Littlewood zeta function conjectures}, revision 1229600719; source exposition citing G. H. Hardy and J. E. Littlewood, \emph{The zeros of Riemann\textquotesingle s zeta-function on the critical line}, Mathematische Zeitschrift 10 (1921), 283--317, doi:10.1007/BF01211614, Conjectures, definition of $N_0(T)$ and item 2.
